description:
The future is here. Building on the huge success of our Solar Frame, the Radio Raceline Terra Frame is an ultra-modern Carbon Fiber race winning machine with a multiple-world championship winning pedigree. With a whole new monocoque construction for increased stiffness, the Terra Frame utilises our new sliding-disc-dropout system (SDDS) for a super simple flat-mount disc brake setup. Taking the same race proven geometry as the original Solar Frame, the Terra bolsters the line with a longer XXXL version for the taller riders out needing a truly unstoppable steed.
The pinnacle of BMX frame design, we’ve tested the Terra frame hard during the 2023-2024 season resulting in a super durable, incredibly lightweight and stiff podium hunting frame. To put it simply, the Terra is the frame you’ve always dreamed of.

• full monocoque technology
• NEW disc-brake-specific model with internal cable routing
• flat mount disc brake only (not compatible with v-brakes)
forged and CNC machined Sliding Dropout Disc System (SDDS) with integrated chain tensioner
• laboratory tested for superior strength to weight
• reinforced stays, BB and head tube areas for increased stiffness
• Designed for 140mm and 120mm rotors (please check 120mm rotor fitment with an authorised Radio Bikes dealer based on your hub and brake calliper dimensions)
• fits 2.0” (50mm) tires MAX
• 30mm of dropout adjustment
• steeper head tube and shorter backend for snappy and responsive race winning geometry
